description: Kernels declared yield: false compile with a clang warning "variable 'v_rem_N' set but not used": the strip-remaining counter is computed but DEFK_SHORT(R) expands to 1 without using it. Present on main before defk-jaj. Done when generated C for yield: false kernels compiles warning-free (e.g. mark the var unused or don't emit it under no-yield).
title: Fix 'set but not used' C warning in yield: false kernels
